reviews.text:
Last month, my beloved dog passed away at the age of 17, and yesterday the hospital delivered beautiful flowers to us.

Even when my husband and I panicked over sudden events like wandering and seizures in his old age, the doctors here always provided accurate advice and gentle support. Thanks to their caring and attentive support, we were able to get through the anxious days of caring for him.

We are filled with gratitude for their warm care until the very end, and for this thoughtful gesture. Thank you so much.

I'll write my honest opinion since I'm a regular customer. My pet hasn't had any serious illnesses yet, so I only go for routine checkups, neutering, and minor procedures, and I don't have many opportunities to talk at length with the doctor. However, all the staff are kind, and it's clear they love animals and work there because of that. One day, I peeked into the back from the reception area and saw several staff members feeding milk to a kitten that looked like it was just born, its eyes not even open yet.

When I asked about it, they said it was a stray and they were looking for an owner for it.

I think that taking care of a rescue cat, which doesn't benefit them in any way, despite how busy they are, is something only animal lovers could do. I've seen reviews mentioning concerns about the staff's manner of speaking, but I think they are generally very helpful and willing to listen to your concerns. I agree that the prices are high.

I graduated from dental school, but I didn't know anything about dogs, so I entrusted my dog's care to the head veterinarian.

My daughter is also a pharmacist, and she was very satisfied with the treatment.

My dog ​​was someone I had raised with great care, and the head veterinarian's treatment was satisfactory. He truly cared for my dog.

As a healthcare professional, I am incredibly grateful for the care my dog ​​received.

Thank you so much for everything over the years.

I graduated from dental school, but I didn't know much about canine dentistry, so I asked the doctor questions.
My daughter is also a pharmacist, and we received satisfactory answers, which gave us peace of mind when we went there.
For other illnesses, they considered the dog's well-being and provided quality of life care—essentially palliative care.
I learned a great deal myself.
I was truly, truly grateful.
Thank you so much for the flowers as well.
There are some negative reviews, but as a healthcare professional, I can say this doctor is excellent.

I was introduced to a hospital that can remove tartar without anesthesia, and I go there every year. The head doctor is very kind and skilled, so I feel completely at ease entrusting my treatment to them.
Many of the doctors are very polite and kind, but the arrogant attitude and behavior of the reception staff are extremely unpleasant.

This is a very reliable hospital where, even when my beloved dog suddenly becomes ill and I'm worried, they can see him right away if I call! Since it's an emergency, there may be a wait, but all the doctors are kind and attentive, so I can leave him in their care with peace of mind. Thank you so much for everything!

We received excellent care for our rescue dog from the time we rescued him until his final moments.
As others have mentioned, there can be long waiting times, but depending on the timing, you might be seen immediately even without an appointment. It seems that some people have made appointments months in advance and travel long distances (I heard this from someone sitting next to me), so it's understandable that they are given priority.
Everyone wants their beloved dog to be their number one priority, after all.
Regarding treatment, if the initial treatment wasn't successful, they always offered a different suggestion and patiently discussed options until we were satisfied.
Since we're dealing with animals that can't speak, there are ups and downs to finding the right solution, but I'm grateful to Toyosu Animal Hospital for their sincere approach.
Thank you very much.
I would definitely like to use their services again if I adopt another rescue dog.

I received excellent care from this hospital from the time I moved to Toyosu until my beloved dog passed away.

When I traveled abroad, they explained everything very carefully, from preparing customs documents and necessary tests to the schedule for obtaining the results. And when my dog's tumor was discovered, they not only handled everything from emergency treatment to referring me to an after-hours hospital and explaining things to the new doctor, but they also cared about me, the owner, and stayed by my side until the very end, telling me to consult them about any concerns I had.

The nurses and doctors all did their utmost to help me. I felt completely at ease entrusting my dog ​​to them until the end. I'm so glad I chose this hospital.

I had my miniature dachshund groomed, and the cut was perfect.

Also, since it's originally a veterinary clinic, I felt reassured knowing they could handle any issues that might arise.

I made a reservation two months in advance for the first appointment of the day, and I was the first one there, but I was made to wait for 30 minutes. I only got to see them after I complained. I wonder if making a reservation was even worth it.

I was worried because finding a suitable veterinary clinic can be tricky, but the head veterinarian and all the staff were so kind that I felt completely at ease leaving my pet in their care. 🐈
My pet still dislikes hospitals, but I think this was the calmest they've ever been, so I plan to continue bringing them in for checkups and other appointments.

I visited this clinic because I heard it was well-known for its oral health services, and after actually being examined, I felt it was a very trustworthy hospital.

The head doctor patiently explained each of my concerns, which put me at ease.

Thank you for your review.

We will continue to strive to provide thorough medical care and clear explanations so that you can visit our clinic with peace of mind.

Please feel free to contact us anytime if you have any concerns.

We look forward to your continued patronage.

I've been taking care of my first dog here since the clinic opened, and I'm so grateful for the kind and attentive care I received from the doctor and staff until the very end. I was able to say goodbye to my dog ​​with peace of mind. 🤗

My second dog is also a patient here; he has allergies, but they handle them with great care. 🤗

I had a chronic condition and was taking medication, so I continued to receive treatment here. However, I developed a foot condition and gradually lost the ability to walk. During my consultations, I was recommended supplements and encouraged to try harder to walk, as I would lose the ability to walk if I stopped moving. However, my condition only got worse.
(Later, a new doctor told me that the pain was preventing me from walking. Even so, I realized they were doing something pretty terrible.)

After changing hospitals, I was able to walk much better thanks to the correct diagnosis and appropriate treatment of my foot condition.

Since this hospital moved to a new facility, the cost of consultations and medications has increased. It's by no means cheap. By the way, there are separate consultation fees for internal medicine and dentistry. However, the dentistry is excellent.

Even though they have a large staff, it's difficult to get through on the phone, and they operate by appointment only, so it's a rare hospital where you can't get a consultation even when you're really sick.

I was so relieved to have my teeth cleaned without anesthesia!

Thank you.

The clinic is clean, the doctor and assistants are kind, and they clean the teeth thoroughly, but the fees are high, including initial consultation fees, follow-up consultation fees, and registration fees!!!
[Postscript]
I came to the clinic because I was concerned about my dog's bad breath, but after three visits for tartar removal in a short period of time, it didn't work, so they prescribed antibiotics and supplements. The bad breath improved when I took the antibiotics, but once I stopped, the bad breath became a problem again (the supplements didn't help). When I went to a different veterinary clinic, they severely scolded me, saying I was stupid for making him take antibiotics!
What if the antibiotics don't work when I really need them to?
It's unthinkable for a veterinary clinic to prescribe antibiotics and supplements. I was even told that...
[Additional Note]
Since then, I've been looking for other veterinary clinics that offer cleanings, but I haven't found one that offers cleanings without anesthesia, or that offers scaling and polishing (many clinics only scrape away tartar. This damages the teeth and makes them more susceptible to tartar buildup, so polishing is necessary). So I've been taking my dog ​​here once or twice a year, while also brushing his teeth and taking care of his breath at home.
I have to wait about two months for a cleaning.
As expected, their dental knowledge is incredible. They cover everything from the alignment to the shape of a dog's teeth, and their explanations are easy to understand!
The director is great at extracting teeth and cleaning in a short amount of time! He leaves the decision up to the patient and doesn't perform unnecessary treatment.
I don't know anything about internal medicine diagnoses, but I definitely recommend this clinic for dental treatment!

You absolutely should not go to this hospital.

I deeply regret trusting their diagnosis and waiting a year to see what would happen.

My condition only worsened, so I went to a different hospital, but I should have gone to a different hospital much sooner.

[Moved to the building next door] We relocated to the building two doors down and reopened on April 26, 2025.

(The new location is where "On the Canal" used to operate.)
